title: Associate IT Systems Engineer
description:
**Job Posting Title**
Associate IT Systems Engineer
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
The Cloud FinOps Engineer is responsible for optimizing cloud financial management practices across enterprise cloud platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). This role serves as the bridge between Finance, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure, and Application teams to ensure cloud resources are cost-effective, properly governed, accurately allocated, and aligned with business objectives.
  
  
The Cloud FinOps Engineer provides financial visibility into cloud spending, develops cost optimization strategies, supports budgeting and forecasting activities, and drives accountability through chargeback/showback reporting. The role is instrumental in establishing a culture of cost awareness while enabling innovation and business growth through efficient cloud adoption.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Cloud Financial Management**

* Monitor and analyze cloud spending across AWS, Azure, and OCI environments.
* Develop and maintain cloud cost allocation, chargeback, and showback models.
* Prepare monthly cloud financial reports, variance analyses, and executive dashboards.
* Support annual budget planning and ongoing cloud spend forecasting.
* Track cloud consumption trends and identify opportunities for cost reduction.

**Cost Optimization**

* Identify underutilized, idle, or oversized cloud resources.
* Recommend and implement optimization initiatives including:

+ Rightsizing computing resources
+ Storage lifecycle optimization
+ Resource scheduling and automation
+ Reserved capacity and savings plans
+ Backup and retention optimization

* Quantify financial impact and realized savings from optimization initiatives.
* Track and report cost savings achieved through FinOps programs.

**Service & Operational Support**

* Monitor and manage the Cloud Infrastructure service requests.
* Triage, prioritize, and coordinate resolution of cloud-related incidents, requests, and operational issues.
* Work with Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure, Application, Security, and vendor teams to ensure timely ticket resolution.
* Provide cost analysis and financial impact assessments for cloud service requests, upgrades, and infrastructure changes.
* Track recurring support trends and identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and service improvement.
* Maintain documentation, knowledge articles, and standard operating procedures related to cloud financial operations and cloud service delivery.
* Ensure cloud service requests comply with established governance, budgeting, tagging, and cost allocation standards.

**Governance & Compliance**

* Develop and enforce cloud tagging and cost attribution standards.
* Partner with cloud platform teams to ensure financial accountability of cloud resources.
* Support Cloud Governance and Cloud Operating Model initiatives.
* Assist in establishing policies, guardrails, and reporting standards related to cloud financial management.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Build dashboards and reports using Power BI, Excel, Cloud Health, native cloud tools, or equivalent platforms.
* Analyze cost drivers, trends, business consumption patterns, and forecasting models.
* Produce cloud KPI and FinOps metrics including:

+ Cost per application
+ Cost per business unit
+ Budget versus actual spending
+ Optimization savings realized

**Business Partnership**

* Collaborate with Finance teams during planning, budgeting, and forecasting cycles.
* Advise application owners and business stakeholders on cloud cost implications.
* Support business cases and total cost of ownership (TCO) analysis for cloud projects.
* Provide cost estimates for new cloud deployments, cloud migrations, and infrastructure modifications.

**Process Improvement & Automation**

* Automate reporting and cost data collection processes.
* Improve cost visibility through tagging, dashboards, and self-service reporting.
* Support continuous improvement of the organization's FinOps maturity and Cloud Operating Model.
* Develop scripts, reports, and automation workflows to improve operational efficiency and cloud cost transparency.

All other duties as assigned.
  
  
**Required Skills And Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, or related field preferred.
* 2+ years of experience in cloud platforms, cloud operations, financial analysis, infrastructure operations, or FinOps.
* Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and/or OCI cost management tools.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Experience developing reports and dashboards using Power BI or similar tools.
* Understanding of cloud infrastructure services, including compute, storage, networking, databases, backup, and disaster recovery.
* Experience working with IT service management platforms such as ServiceNow, Freshservice, or equivalent ticketing systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**About Dauch**
Dauch Corporation is a premier Driveline and Metal Forming supplier serving the global automotive industry with a powertrain-agnostic product portfolio that supports electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles. The company is headquartered in Detroit, MI, with operations that span 24 countries and more than 175 locations. Formed through the acquisition of Dowlais Group plc and its subsidiaries - GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy, Dauch unites deep engineering roots with global manufacturing capabilities and an entrepreneurial spirit to move mobility forward. Visit www.dauch.com to learn more.

title: Associate Senior Systems Engineer
description:
**Ready to take your career global?**
Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Associate Senior Systems Engineer to join our ever evolving infrastructure team and help shape the future of global commerce.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**
**System Engineer II – Infrastructure Support (GCP / Kubernetes / Windows)**
**Summary Of This Role**
Providing day-to-day support for GCP infrastructure and Kubernetes-based infrastructure, with a focus on Google Cloud Compute Engine, Windows environments, and automated delivery through Terraform and GitHub.
  
  
Supports the operation, stability, and ongoing improvement of cloud-based infrastructure services, ensuring reliable performance in a production and compliance-driven environment.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**
Support day-to-day operation of GCP-based infrastructure, including Compute Engine workloads and Kubernetes platform and cluster configurations
  
  
Work with leadership and technical teams to support the strategic direction of the Infrastructure Engineering function
  
  
Support automated build and deployment practices using infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines
  
  
Maintain installation, configuration, and operational procedures, and contribute to improving runbooks and documentation
  
  
Participate in infrastructure support and engineering activities across BAU operations and project delivery
  
  
Provide incident support, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis for production issues
  
  
Work closely with networking, security, and application teams to resolve issues and support service delivery
  
  
Support compliance, audit, and security requirements across managed systems
  
  
Contribute to improving the availability, performance, and resilience of infrastructure services
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
  
  
2–5 years of hands-on experience supporting cloud-based infrastructure in a production environment, with exposure to GCP (Compute Engine), Windows systems, and Kubernetes-based platforms.
  
  
General understanding of cloud networking and access controls, with experience working alongside networking and security teams.
  
  
Good communication skills.
  
  
**It’s a bonus if you have**
Hands-on experience supporting Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments from an infrastructure support perspective, with a focus on Google Compute Engine (GCE) and Windows-based workloads
  
  
Good working understanding of cloud networking and access controls (including service accounts), with experience working alongside dedicated networking and security teams
  
  
Working knowledge of Kubernetes (GKE preferred) from an infrastructure support perspective, including cluster configuration, namespace configuration, ingress/service routing, and security configuration, along with troubleshooting of infrastructure-related issues
  
  
Solid Windows systems engineering background, including server build, patching, and operational support in a cloud-hosted environment
  
  
Experience with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform, for provisioning and maintaining cloud resources
  
  
Familiarity with GitHub or similar source control platforms, supporting CI/CD-driven workflows and deployments
  
  
Solid understanding of production support practices, including incident support, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and working from runbooks
  
  
Experience supporting services in a regulated or compliance-driven environment (e.g. PCI), with awareness of security, audit, and change requirements
  
  
Working knowledge of Active Directory, including user and group management and basic policy administration
  
  
Basic working knowledge of Linux systems, sufficient to support Kubernetes-based workloads
  
  
Understanding of security and access control concepts, including IAM, service accounts, and patch and vulnerability management
  
  
Ability to contribute to both operational support and project delivery activities, working across application, infrastructure, and security teams in a distributed environment
  
  
Strong collaboration and communication skills
  
  
**Key Qualifications Needs**
2–5 years’ experience supporting cloud infrastructure in production environments
  
  
Hands-on experience with GCP (Google Compute Engine) and Windows-based workloads
  
  
Working knowledge of Kubernetes (GKE preferred), supporting application deployments and troubleshooting
  
  
Experience with Terraform and infrastructure as code, and GitHub-based workflows
  
  
Strong production support skills, including incident response, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis
  
  
Working knowledge of Active Directory and core access management concepts
  
  
Basic understanding of Linux systems in support of Kubernetes workloads
  
  
Familiarity with security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. PCI)
  
  
Experience working alongside networking and security teams in a shared responsibility model
  
  
**About The Team**
Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.
  
  
Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

title: Expert Systems Engineer
description:
**Job Description: Expert Systems Engineer \| Telecom Engineer**
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a Telecom Engineer with hands\-on network operations experience to manage ISP service orders and support circuit operations for U.S. clients. The role will coordinate internet circuit orders, troubleshoot connectivity issues, and work with carriers, clients, and internal network teams to drive timely resolution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Submit and manage ISP orders, including new circuit installations, upgrades, disconnects, relocations, and service changes.
* Coordinate with clients, ISPs, carriers, site contacts, and internal network teams throughout the order lifecycle.
* Track order milestones, installation schedules, provisioning, testing, and service activation; follow up on delays and blockers.
* Open, monitor, and escalate provider tickets for outages, degradation, packet loss, latency, and other circuit issues.
* Troubleshoot connectivity issues and coordinate circuit testing, turn\-up, failover validation, and restoration with network engineers.
* Support network incident response by gathering circuit and device information, assessing service impact, and communicating updates.
* Maintain accurate records of circuit IDs, bandwidth, provider details, site information, order status, ticket history, and escalation contacts.
* Prepare status reports and communicate risks, delays, outages, and resolution progress clearly.
* Follow operational procedures, change controls, SLAs, and client communication requirements.


**Required Network Engineering Experience**
* Hands\-on experience in a network operations or engineering role supporting enterprise networks.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4 addressing, subnetting, VLANs, routing, DNS, DHCP, and default gateways.
* Familiarity with routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF, including how to gather information for troubleshooting and escalation.
* Experience troubleshooting WAN and internet connectivity issues, including latency, packet loss, jitter, bandwidth, and route reachability.
* Familiarity with network devices such as routers, switches, firewalls, and SD\-WAN appliances.
* Ability to use command\-line tools such as ping, traceroute/tracert, and nslookup to perform initial troubleshooting.
* Experience reviewing interface status, error counters, logs, routing information, and circuit handoff details.
* Understanding of common enterprise connectivity services such as Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), broadband, Ethernet, MPLS, and SD\-WAN underlay circuits.
* Ability to distinguish between provider\-side, access\-circuit, and customer network issues and engage the appropriate support teams.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Experience in telecom, ISP, carrier, or network operations.
* Experience working with ISP portals, ticketing systems, order\-management tools, and spreadsheets.
* Strong vendor and stakeholder coordination skills, including professional and persistent escalation.
* Clear written and verbal communication, attention to detail, and effective follow\-through across multiple concurrent requests.
* Ability to support U.S. business hours and participate in an on\-call or after\-hours rotation if required.


**Success measures**
* ISP orders are submitted accurately and completed within agreed timelines.
* Circuit outages and performance issues are escalated promptly and tracked through resolution.
* Stakeholders receive timely, clear updates.
* Circuit inventory and order records remain accurate and current.
* SLA, change\-control, and client communication requirements are consistently met.

title: Enterprise Systems Engineer- Application Deployment & Infrastructure
description:
We are building a team responsible for deploying, upgrading, and maintaining an enterprise server\-based application platform on customer infrastructure. Deployments span on\-premise data centres as well as Azure and AWS cloud environments. You will own the full infrastructure lifecycle — from environment preparation and installation to hardening, patching, upgrades, monitoring, and troubleshooting — working directly with client IT teams.
 





 The application platform itself is a leading enterprise geospatial product (ArcGIS Enterprise). No prior experience with it is required — we provide full training and certification support. What we need from you is strong, hands\-on IT infrastructure fundamentals.
 




  




**Key Responsibilities** 
* Prepare, validate, and configure server environments (Windows Server) on client on\-premise infrastructure and on Azure / AWS.
* Install and configure multi\-tier enterprise software: web tiers, application servers, and database back\-ends across single\-machine and distributed/high\-availability architectures.
* Configure web servers and reverse proxies (IIS, Apache/Tomcat, Nginx), including SSL/TLS certificates, DNS entries, and load balancing.
* Plan and execute version upgrades and patch cycles with minimal downtime, including rollback planning, backup, and restore procedures.
* Set up relational databases (Microsoft SQL Server/PostgreSQL/Oracle) — installation, connectivity, and backups.
* Implement monitoring, log analysis, and alerting; troubleshoot performance, networking, and service\-availability issues in production environments.
* Work with client firewall/security teams on port configurations, network segmentation, and security hardening per client policies.
* Automate repetitive deployment and maintenance tasks using PowerShell, Python etc.
* Document architectures, runbooks, and standard operating procedures; maintain configuration records for each client environment.



  




**Mandatory Requirements** 
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience administering Windows Server and in production environments.
* Solid grasp of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, ports and firewalls, reverse proxies, load balancers, VPNs.
* Working knowledge of PKI / SSL\-TLS certificates — issuing, installing, renewing, and troubleshooting certificate chains.
* Experience deploying or managing workloads on Azure or AWS (VMs, virtual networks/VPCs, security groups, storage, IAM).
* Experience with enterprise web/application servers (IIS, Tomcat, Apache, or Nginx).
* Scripting ability in PowerShell or Python for automation and diagnostics.
* Strong troubleshooting methodology — comfortable reading logs, isolating faults across web/app/db/network layers.

Senior Rust Systems Engineer – Embedded Proxy & Appliance
description:
Senior Rust Systems Engineer – Embedded Proxy \& Appliance
 
 Remote, India \| Direct Hire \| 6\+ Years Total (3\+ Years Production Rust)
 



**About Securly** 




 Securly is a K\-12 EdTech company built around one mission: keeping students safe and well, both online and off. Our platform gives schools the infrastructure to filter and monitor web traffic, flag signs of self\-harm or bullying, and support student wellness — all while giving IT teams tools that hold up on real school networks, not just in a demo. That mission runs straight through this role: the edge proxy appliance is core infrastructure sitting inside thousands of school networks, and it has to work every single school day, at scale, without fail.
 



 We're a team of roughly 330 people across Pune, the US, and the UK, working across engineering, product, and customer\-facing teams to build and support that platform. Engineering in Pune plays a central role in building the systems that make Securly's safety mission possible — this isn't a satellite team, it's where core infrastructure like this gets built.
 



**The Role** 




 If you've spent your career close to the hardware — device drivers, kernel modules, cross\-compilation, bring\-up on constrained systems — and you're deep in production Rust, this is a chance to own the embedded proxy software running on a fleet of appliances deployed across thousands of school networks, from the OS layer up through the AWS control plane managing it all.
 



**Must\-Haves:** 



* Embedded Linux fundamentals — device drivers, kernel modules, cross\-compilation, or hardware bring\-up
* 3\+ years hands\-on production Rust in a systems or embedded context (not app/web Rust)
* 6\+ years total engineering experience
* Systems/network programming — TCP stream handling, socket programming, transparent proxying
* Docker/containerization for constrained/appliance deployment
* Performance testing and profiling — load testing, memory/CPU profiling, flame graph analysis
* Working knowledge of AWS and IaC concepts



**Strongly Preferred:** 
 Named fleet/IoT/embedded device product on your resume, C/C\+\+ or Go alongside Rust, eBPF/netfilter/HAProxy/Envoy exposure
 



**Nice to Have:** 
 RADIUS, observability (CloudWatch/Splunk/SLOs)
 



 Securly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristic.
